sources.entry: OTOBO - Flexible web-based ticketing system used for customer service, help desk, IT service management. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-3.0 Perl/Docker

summary.one_liner: OTOBO is a flexible, web-based open-source ticketing system for service organizations such as IT help desks, customer service centers, and call centers.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OTOBO as a web-based ticketing tool for streamlining communication in service organizations. It provides classical ticketing functionality and a knowledgebase/FAQ with internal and external interfaces. It can automate processes and be extended with an ITSM component that includes a CMDB for tracking IT components and other assets. The project is a fork of OTRS Community Edition, started in 2019. The README points to separate documentation and a features page for details. Software and hardware requirements are stated in the documentation, not the README.
use_cases: operate a call center ticket queue
maintain an internal or external knowledgebase and FAQ
IT service management with a CMDB
notable: Fork of OTRS Community Edition, started in 2019
Includes a knowledgebase/FAQ with internal and external interfaces
Optional ITSM component with a CMDB for tracking IT and other assets
Professional services and a managed hosting version offered by Rother OSS GmbH
caveats: Installation and run instructions are not included in the README; they are referred to the external documentation
Software and hardware requirements are only in the external documentation
Professional support, consulting, and a managed version are offered commercially by Rother OSS GmbH
